posts.author: DeBaby28
posts.body:
Hello Everyone.
I am looking to make my game full screen, yet when I expand it I have two black bars on the side(windowed mode). I would like the game to expand or shrink based on player's computer width. How would I achieve this? Any help is appreciated. I am currently using RPG Maker MV.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
There are many threads discussing this, if you do a Google for some of the terms.
The black bars are because the dimensions of your game window aren't the same aspect ratio as the monitor you're using.
If you change your game window dimensions (such as with the Community plugin or Yanfly's Core), you won't see black bars.
I don't know if there's a way to stop the window from going wider than some defined size - that's what maximize does, by definition in Windows.

posts.body:
